answer: The first paper in the arXiv cs.CL new submissions whose title mentions agents is arXiv 2608.26130, titled "Agents Don't Paginate: First-Chunk Selection for LLM Tool Responses" by 3 authors (Tatiana Petrova, Andrei Mazniak, Radu State). The paper studies how coding agents handle tool responses exceeding token budgets, finding that improving information placement precision doesn't improve accuracy because agents can recover needed data anywhere in the chunk. The PDF is at https://arxiv.org/pdf/2608.26130
